unresolved_fit: V4 body includes a provisional rear through-hole OLED header route; exact 1x8 housing, keyed orientation, cable bend and frame retention remain unverified.
The real UC2 XH balance plug and USB-C cable positions, insertion and strain relief are unmeasured; charger load isolation during charging is unverified.
Speaker 28x7 mm envelope does not include terminals or attached JST plug; the V3 side notch and head opening are still only a nominal plug proxy until the actual cable is fitted.
Servo plug wire bend, exact hip mount and physical SG90 horn/shaft fit remain unmeasured.
V3 head merges the V2 driver hood, enlarged side speaker route and M2 faceplate bosses; actual plugs, cable bend, boss pilot grip and screw lengths still need a physical fit test.
No gait-pose, torque, contact-force, friction or fall test has been performed.
